_doc: M7-05 — the strings the Die Panel (S12) shows, and nothing else. Same reason as content/board/board.json: a loc key named only from C# is an orphan and an orphan is fatal, so this document is where the panel's keys are named. One name and one effect line per face kind, because the panel's whole purpose is that a hidden die is a hostile die. 🔒 The effect lines deliberately carry NO number. Every magnitude a face has — how far Surge and Fortune and Chain move, how much Surge heals, how many times Chain may chain — lives in FaceEffectResolver inside the rules and is marked TUNABLE in the design set; a number transcribed into a string here would be a second copy of a balance value that could not be tuned with the first. The lines state each face's identity instead, which is the part that does not move. `facesUnavailable` is the panel's honest admission that it cannot show which face sits in which slot: the type that composes a die from talents, mounts, perks and forge upgrades is internal to the rules and is not wired to a run at all, so no client can read the composed die today.
